activity_summary: You were past the shut stalls and you did not turn back. You said the pages were for the fire and that they would come home after.

entities.name: William Shakespeare

facets.activity: Passed the shut stalls at Paul's

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not turning back for a book I can buy by daylight.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The pages are for the fire, and they come home after.
